regions.name: The Hive Capital
regions.blurb: A purple spire-city around Spire Lake, where the election is decided and the Adventurers' Guild HQ stands.

regions.name: Emberforge Peaks
regions.blurb: Volcanic badlands under Mount Cinderheart. House Laser's homeland.

regions.name: Tidecry Coast
regions.blurb: Rainy cliffs, pine forests and the River Weeping. House Teardrop's homeland.

regions.name: Prism Expanse
regions.blurb: A crystal desert of dunes, mesas and mirages. House Glass's homeland.

regions.name: Dreamveil Meadows
regions.blurb: Golden meadows, flower fields, lakes and windmills. House Moonbeam's homeland.

regions.name: The Hollow
regions.blurb: A sunken crater where the Skull Chogs gather at night.

regions.name: Frogsong Wetlands
regions.blurb: Marshes, lagoons and the original Chog Pond.

regions.name: Rug Coast & Pirate Isles
regions.blurb: Smugglers, pirates and the infamous Rug Docks.

regions.name: The Unminted Wastes
regions.blurb: The edge of the ledger. Rumors of a golden Chog.

regions.name: The Demon Realm
regions.blurb: Across the Bridge of Liquidation waits the Demon King's Castle.
